title: PM Modi positions Brics as an inclusive, not anti-west, forum
content: Prime Minister Modi opened the Brics summit, demanding urgent United Nations Security Council reforms. He stressed transforming global governance from privilege to partnership for developing nations. Modi proposed Brics draft ten proposals for inclusive global governance and multilateralism. He also called for a Seafarers Emergency Support Network for maritime workers. The summit aims to empower the Global South as rule-shapers, not rule-takers.

title: WTC points table: Where does India stand after England's 3-0 whitewash of Pakistan?
content: Pakistan’s tour ended on a disappointing note despite major changes before the final Test. The team made several changes to the playing squad and coaching staff ahead of the Edgbaston match, but the move did not change the outcome.

title: Why Oracle founder Larry Ellison changed his mind on a $7.5 billion stock sale in a day
content: Larry Ellison cancelled his Oracle stock sale plan shortly after its disclosure. No shares were sold under the arrangement which was set to expire later this year. This plan would have allowed the sale of fifty million Oracle shares. The cancellation highlights differences between US and European trading regulations for executives. Oracle's stock has experienced a decline while the company faces increased job cut costs.

title: India wrestling faces a new test after generations of Asian Games glory
content: From 1954 Manila to 2022 Hangzhou, generations of Indian wrestlers have built a proud Asian Games legacy. Now, heading to Aichi-Nagoya, Indian wrestling will strive to overcome pre-Games doping setbacks and mount an emphatic medal charge.

title: Google just moved 90 people out of DeepMind, and staff are asking why
content: Google is moving its roughly 90-person AI responsibility team out of Google DeepMind and into its global affairs organisation, the division that handles policy and lobbying. The shift, starting in September, is part of a wider reorganisation that folds DeepMind closer into central Google. Some employees worry the team will lose access to Gemini researchers, weakening AI safety work. Team lead Helen King says access and resources stay intact.

title: How PM Modi's meeting with Iran President facilitated Brics declaration
content: Following intense late-night negotiations, Brics nations have come together to issue a joint declaration addressing vital issues, including the protection of civilian and peaceful nuclear sites. The leaders reiterated the critical role of constructive dialogue in achieving regional stability. Furthermore, they collectively reaffirmed their resolve to combat terrorism in all its manifestations and called for extensive reforms of the United Nations Security Council.

title: Maine mother reunites with firefighter who delivered her son 24 years ago
content: In a heartwarming twist of fate, a Maine mother, Maddie Marks, and firefighter Robert Shay Jr. have rekindled their bond nearly twenty-five years after an extraordinary roadside delivery during a 9/11 memorial service. This unexpected reunion in 2026, facilitated by mutual friends, allowed them to reflect on the emotional weight of that significant day, bringing closure and a shared sense of nostalgia for their remarkable journey.

title: Israel released 28 wild donkeys in desert; 44 years later, they created an oasis
content: In an effort to rejuvenate the parched landscape of Israel's Ramon Crater, wild donkeys were brought back into the ecosystem. These resilient animals played a crucial role by creating waterholes, which became essential for desert wildlife. Additionally, their droppings helped spread acacia seeds, promoting the growth of trees. Their natural movements resulted in water-retaining depressions, significantly transforming the area's ecology into a thriving environment that has caught global attention.

title: Mark Zuckerberg is back on Elon Musk's X after three years, and it is not personal
content: In 2026, Mark Zuckerberg made a surprising return to Elon Musk's social network X, seizing the opportunity to unveil Meta's latest AI innovation, Muse. By engaging with specific engineering talent and researchers on X, Zuckerberg aims to leverage diverse online communities for fostering discussions, effectively amplifying Meta's AI initiatives in front of potential developers.

title: Villagers tie technician to tower over poor network
content: In Hardauli, Uttar Pradesh, locals took matters into their own hands as they detained a telecom technician, tying him to a mobile tower. Their frustration over ongoing 5G connectivity issues boiled over into this unusual protest. The police have since registered a case against the villagers, marking a significant incident in rural India's increasing dependence on mobile telecommunications.

title: 'In-laws may kill me': Noida woman’s last call before husband pushes from terrace
content: A husband was arrested for allegedly pushing his wife to death from their home.  Unmet dowry demands of thirty lakh rupees and a car fueled the dispute.  The wife had reportedly called her brother fearing for her life before the incident.  She later died from injuries sustained after falling from the terrace.  Police are investigating the circumstances and searching for other family members.

title: Trump's childhood home sells for $1.93M after a dramatic makeover
content: The Tudor-style home in Queens that once belonged to Donald Trump has been sold for $1.93 million, marking a significant transformation from its previous state. Developer Tommy Lin bought it for $835,000, pouring over $500,000 into renovations after years of neglect. The property’s ties to Trump drew numerous interested buyers, making history a key selling point.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35m mansion: Why are neighbours worried about lake views?
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million waterfront mansion in Bratenahl, Ohio, has faced an unexpected neighborhood dispute over proposed fencing. Some residents reportedly worried the original plans could interfere with their Lake Erie views, leading to discussions with neighbors. A section of the fence extending toward the beach was later scrapped. Despite the disagreement, local officials have welcomed Kelce, while emphasizing the importance of both community ties and privacy.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s $6.7m estate: Why did his Cheshire mansion lose value?
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s former Cheshire estate was listed for about $7.4 million in 2023 but later saw its asking price fall to $6.7 million. The 23-acre property has a seven-bedroom mansion, indoor pool, gym, cinema, tennis and padel courts. Ronaldo moved there after returning to Manchester United but later relocated before leaving England for Al-Nassr.

title: 81-year-old meets schoolmate PM Modi to seek CBI probe in land dispute
content: An 81-year-old man approached Prime Minister Narendra Modi for help.  He is seeking justice in a long-standing land dispute case.  The resident alleges encroachment and forged documents related to his property.  Following the meeting, municipal authorities have scheduled a hearing for September 16.  Representatives from the involved construction companies must attend this important meeting.

title: India’s gem exports rise 3.14% in August as studded gold jewellery shipments surge
content: India's gem and jewellery exports saw a 3.14% increase in August, reaching $2.30 billion. This growth was primarily fueled by a significant rise in studded gold jewellery shipments. Diamond export volumes also contributed positively to the overall export performance during the month. Plain gold jewellery exports experienced a decline due to rising gold prices and input costs. The industry is evolving into a global hub for design and value addition.

title: Sabalenka smashes racket, hits ball into crowd after US Open defeat to Rybakina
content: Elena Rybakina won her first US Open title on Saturday after beating Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the final, completing a run that also took her to the No. 1 spot in the WTA rankings.

title: India needs to launch the space act it keeps scrubbing
content: As India's space industry develops, it urgently needs a Space Act to provide stringent legal support. Initiated in 2020, the opening of this sector, alongside the establishment of IN-SPACe, has highlighted gaps in existing policies. A robust Space Act would not only outline company rights but also enhance regulatory clarity, paving the way for the sector's growth and improved global positioning.

title: West Bengal shuts down 252 madrasas, sends show-cause notices to 100
content: West Bengal's minority affairs department has issued closure notices to 252 madrasas. About 100 other madrasas received show-cause notices for non-compliance. This action follows a survey of unaided and unauthorized madrasas across the state. The department aims to ensure modern education for all students. Further verification and enforcement actions will continue.

title: ‘Slipped and fell’ on saleswoman, then kissed her twice: Mumbai man gets 1-year jail
content: A Mumbai court convicted a cleaner for forcibly kissing a saleswoman last year. The judge dismissed the cleaner's claim of accidentally falling onto the victim. Evidence showed the act was intentional, involving criminal force and sexual overtures. The cleaner received one year rigorous imprisonment and a fine for his actions. This conviction occurred under the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita laws.

title: Game time after injury hiccups: Full-strength India take on Afghanistan in 1st T20I
content: Shreyas Iyer is set to captain India's full-strength T20I team against Afghanistan, marking the return of pace ace Jasprit Bumrah after a lengthy injury break. This series acts as crucial preparation for the upcoming Asian Games in Japan, where the team looks forward to engaging with athletes from various sports. Iyer is particularly thrilled about his debut experience at a multi-sport event.

title: Brics 2026: Piyush Goyal hails unanimous adoption of New Delhi Declaration
content: At the latest summit, BRICS leaders unanimously endorsed the New Delhi Declaration, marking a significant step toward a resilient strategic partnership. This declaration focuses on fostering cooperation in emerging technologies and strengthening digital infrastructure. Additionally, it aims to bolster the New Development Bank and enhance supply chain resilience, all while underscoring the leaders' commitment to solidarity and mutual respect.

title: 12-ft king cobra swallows python in Karnataka garden, regurgitates it later
content: A dramatic scene unfolded in a Karnataka garden when a twelve-foot king cobra was spotted consuming a python. Swift action from a snake rescuer ensured the cobra was safely relocated, leading to the unexpected moment when it regurgitated its meal. This serpent, known for its expertise in hunting snakes, highlights the importance of caution, warning onlookers to keep their distance from dangerous wildlife situations.

title: UP govt misusing Goonda Act for harassment: Allahabad HC
content: The Allahabad High Court has raised serious concerns about the misuse of the Uttar Pradesh Goonda Act, describing it as a potential weapon for harassment. In its ruling, the court quashed an order that expelled Zahid Ali from Gonda district, highlighting the questionable basis of an acquitted case and an outdated report. The court emphasized the necessity for careful consideration when applying such impactful laws.

title: Wushu athlete Divyanshi accepts Asiad squad axe, alleges harassment by Roshibina

Now prioritising her fitness, she aims for future triumphs with gold medals in sight. Additionally, she continues to raise issues of harassment by a peer, but feels reassured by the federation's backing and the supportive stance of its officials.

title: ‘Need to reflect on our mistakes’: Babar Azam calls for changes after 0-3 loss
content: Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan, calls for a candid introspection following England's clean sweep of the series. The Pakistani team is urged to evaluate their squad and establish the most effective eleven. Notably, the final Test showcased improvements in batting performance, highlighted by debutant Razaullah's impactful contributions. This 3-0 series defeat leaves Pakistan languishing at the bottom of the World Test Championship rankings.

title: Mass protests erupt in Germany as AfD eyes breakthrough in eastern states

The AfD's lead in national opinion polls and its upcoming eastern state election objectives raise alarms over its increasing power. Mainstream parties continue to adopt a strategy of isolation, refusing to collaborate with the AfD as tensions escalate.

title: 'Reacher' star Alan Ritchson and wife Catherine confirm split after 20 years

They emphasized that their friendship remains a priority, especially for their three sons. Having met as teenagers and tied the knot in 2006, the couple has requested privacy as they navigate this new chapter. Ritchson had initiated divorce proceedings last December, with a brief reconciliation occurring in March.

title: RBI rejects Tata Sons' bid to stay private, directs listing

title: New No. 1 Elena Rybakina dethrones Aryna Sabalenka to win US Open title

In a thrilling showdown against Aryna Sabalenka, Rybakina showcased exceptional skill and poise, winning her third Grand Slam and second major title of the year, while Sabalenka's remarkable run at Flushing Meadows came to an unexpected end.

Renowned for his extraordinary work on timeless films such as The Last Emperor, Thomas's dedication spanned over fifty years and earned him nine Academy Awards.
